_comment: Voiced captions for the gallery, keyed by image path. 'by' is the author (ethan | jacob) for color-coded display. These are display captions; write separate descriptive alt text for accessibility.

/images/stops/burlington/cover.jpg.caption: The driveway I grew up staring out of. One last look before we pointed the car west.

/images/stops/burlington/01.jpg.caption: The cooler got its own seat. I got told I overpacked. Both true.

/images/stops/burlington/02.jpg.caption: The send-off committee. Abby made me an actual handwritten snack list.

/images/stops/niagara-falls/cover.jpg.caption: You hear it before you see it. Then you stop talking.

/images/stops/niagara-falls/01.jpg.caption: Soaked through and neither of us willing to leave.

/images/stops/niagara-falls/02.jpg.caption: He pretended the snow globe was dumb. He bought it anyway.

/images/stops/detroit/cover.jpg.caption: Hitsville, U.S.A. We'll have to come back when the new space opens.

/images/stops/detroit/01.jpg.caption: Coney dogs. A religious experience. No further notes.

/images/stops/detroit/02.jpg.caption: Evidence: a handsome scarecrow attacked by bees. Vault material.

/images/stops/chicago/cover.jpg.caption: Tall, loud, indifferent. I found it comforting.

/images/stops/chicago/01.jpg.caption: For one second the light off the lake looked exactly like home.

/images/stops/chicago/02.jpg.caption: I ate deep dish like regular pizza. I regret nothing and everything.

/images/stops/st-paul/cover.jpg.caption: A country road and an old oak tree. Jacob never had to say it out loud.

/images/stops/st-paul/01.jpg.caption: I hung back until he reached for me. Then I was already there.

/images/stops/st-paul/02.jpg.caption: Later, in the city, he laughed at something dumb I said. That's the one that mattered.

/images/stops/badlands/cover.jpg.caption: Pink, bone, rust, forever. Worth setting an alarm in the dark.

/images/stops/badlands/01.jpg.caption: I didn't watch the sunrise much. I watched him watch it.

/images/stops/badlands/02.jpg.caption: Nothing around for miles. Exactly what we came for.

/images/stops/rocky-mountain/cover.jpg.caption: So many freaking stars. Honestly almost rude.

/images/stops/rocky-mountain/01.jpg.caption: Confidently naming two constellations to a man too kind to correct me.

/images/stops/rocky-mountain/02.jpg.caption: Four jackets in the trunk. Still wearing his. The running theme of this trip.

/images/stops/zion/cover.jpg.caption: Two thousand feet of red rock. Ethan called it a metaphor. It is a canyon.

/images/stops/zion/01.jpg.caption: Bawling at a rock formation in front of forty strangers, completely unbothered.

/images/stops/zion/02.jpg.caption: A kiss on the trail, out in the open, like it was nothing.

/images/stops/las-vegas/cover.jpg.caption: Vegas on the Fourth of July. Complete sensory chaos. Thriving.

/images/stops/las-vegas/01.jpg.caption: He bet zero dollars and said he already won. I'm still not over it.

/images/stops/las-vegas/02.jpg.caption: Three firework shows from one parking garage. He was right, as always.

/images/stops/big-sur/cover.jpg.caption: The road runs out right here. I'm glad it does.

/images/stops/big-sur/01.jpg.caption: Wearing the spare jacket I swore I'd never need. He runs warm, I run cold. We fit.

/images/stops/big-sur/02.jpg.caption: The snow globe survived all three thousand miles. It's going on the shelf.
